title: Projection factorization of a pulled-back tensor precomposition
statement: Let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, with independent ambient derived categories and all open derived categories on Y [def-pc-derived-category]. Let L=derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes]. Let F:D_QCoh(X)→D_QCoh(Y) have a natural identification hF of its ambient inclusion with Rf* [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let P∈D_QCoh(X), perfect I∈D(Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex], i:I→1_Y, and any e:L(1_Y)≅1_X. Assume R=L(I)⊗P has quasi-coherent cohomology for the fixed tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Define j:R→P by (L(i)⊗id_P);(e⊗id_P);λ_P. Then there exists t:F(R)→I⊗F(P) in D(Y) such that the underlying morphism of F(j) is t;(i⊗id_F(P));λ_F(P). There is no adjunction F⊣a, β, Q, restriction or annihilation hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0E4G, Lemma 48.4.4, final projection-formula paragraph; perfect.tex, Tags 08DW, 08DX and 08EU

proof.text: Apply the monoidal-adjunction bridge for the exact transported pullback and specified direct image. Perfectness implies quasi-coherence, so lift I into D_QCoh(Y) and apply perfect_tensor_hom_duality to obtain an exact pairing I,J. The mate p of the inverse tensorator followed by the counit equals the conjugate of commTensorLeft at J, by monoidal_projection_conjugate; the latter is an isomorphism. Thus p is invertible.

Set t0=inv p. Cancel p and transpose under the pullback adjunction. Hom-equivalence naturality, map_whiskerRight and map_leftUnitor reduce the identity to two instances of whisker_exchange and left-unitor naturality. This proves the factorization with the monoidal unit comparison e0. The Lean private helper projection_factorization contains the complete calculation.

For arbitrary e define d=lambda_P.inv;(e0.inv;e.hom) tensor id;lambda_P.hom. Tensor bifunctoriality and cancellation show j=j0;d. Set t=t0;(id_I tensor R(d)); whisker_exchange and left-unitor naturality give the required ambient factorization. The proved helper projection_factorization_unit_change records this calculation.

Let Q be the tensor object with its supplied quasi-coherence witness, and let j:Q to P be the full-subcategory morphism. Naturality of hF gives F(j)=hF_Q;R(j);hF_P.inv. Substitute the ambient factorization and define the final factor hF_Q;t;(id_I tensor hF_P.inv). Tensor interchange and left-unitor naturality prove the displayed equation.

theorem exists_derivedTensor_precomposition_projection
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (hF : F ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y) ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X) ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (I : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (hI : Scheme.IsPerfect Y I) (i : I ⟶ 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))
    (e : (derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f).obj (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)) ≅
      𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (hR : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X
      ((derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f).obj I ⊗ P.obj)) :
    ∃ t : (F.obj ⟨(derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f).obj I ⊗ P.obj, hR⟩).obj ⟶
        I ⊗ (F.obj P).obj,
      (F.map (ObjectProperty.homMk
        ((derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f).map i ▷ P.obj ≫
          e.hom ▷ P.obj ≫ (λ_ P.obj).hom))).hom =
        t ≫ i ▷ (F.obj P).obj ≫ (λ_ (F.obj P).obj).hom
